data.name: Ama
data.gender_notes: Ama is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic language, Ama means 'mother of Ibrahim'. This name holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam as Hajar, the wife of Prophet Ibrahim, is also known as Ama or Umm Ibrahim. Hajar is the mother of Prophet Ismail and Ishaq, both of whom were born through God's command to Ibrahim. The name Ama is a reminder of Hajar's unwavering faith and perseverance, inspiring strength and resilience for generations.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of the revered mother of Prophet Ibrahim
data.etymology: Ama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mother of prophet Ibrahim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ama total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: أما
in_arabic.meaning: أما تعني القرب والحماية الالهية للانسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أما مشتق من الجذر العربي (أمأ) والذي يدل على معنى القرب والحماية. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الأحيان كاسم للإناث في الثقافة العربية، وغالبًا ما يُعطى للمولودات حديثًا كرمز للحب والرعاية الإلهية. كما يمكن أن يعني الثقة والاعتماد على الله في اللغة العربية.

in_urdu.name: اماں
in_urdu.meaning: اماں مطلب ہے محفوظی اور قربانی کی علامت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام اماں عربی جڑ (أمأ) سے نکلا ہے، جو حفاظت اور قربانی کے معنی میں ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام اکثر ان کی محفوظی اور الہی محبت کی علامت کے طور پر دیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ نام روحانی معنی بھی رکھتا ہے، جو اللہ کی طرف سے عطا کردہ تحفظ کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अमा
in_hindi.meaning: अमा का अर्थ है ईश्वरीय संरक्षण और माँ जैसा प्रेम
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अमा की उत्पत्ति संस्कृत और अरबी भाषाओं में हुई है। यह नाम मातृत्व और ईश्वरीय प्रेम का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर मातृत्व और दैवीय सुरक्षा के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम पवित्रता और आध्यात्मिकता का भी प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: امې
in_pashto.meaning: امې معنی د الهي حفاظت او مينې نښه
in_pashto.long_meaning: د امې نوم عربي ريښو (أمأ) څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د الهي حفاظت او قرباني معنی لري. په پښتني کلتور کې، دا نوم ډیری وختونه د الهي مينې او پاملرنې د نښې په توګه کارول کیږي. دا نوم د روحاني پيغام حامل دی، د الهي حفاظت او پاملرنې ښودنه کوي.

The name holds spiritual significance, indicating trust in Allah's providence and protection. Across Muslim cultures, Ama represents a cherished and meaningful name, embodying virtues of compassion and security.

historical_references.reference: Ama bint Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, a notable female Sufi scholar and poetess of the 11th century in Andalusia.
historical_references.context: Andalusia, a region in the Iberian Peninsula, was a cultural and intellectual melting pot under Muslim rule. Ama was revered for her deep spiritual insight and poetic compositions, which reflected the Sufi mystic tradition.

historical_references.reference: Ama al-Sabakiyya (The Mother of the Sabians), a significant figure in early Islamic history who is believed to have lived around the late 7th or early 8th century in Iraq.
historical_references.context: Ama al-Sabakiyya was a renowned healer and a leader of a religious sect known as the Sabians. Although much about her life is shrouded in mystery, she is remembered for her remarkable abilities and her commitment to preserving pre-Islamic religious knowledge.

The name holds deep significance in Islamic tradition and continues to be used in various contexts today.
